articles.summary: Acquisition strengthens NetApp Novus, high-performance storage, with differentiated metadata technology and a parallel file architecture purpose-built for AI NetApp® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, today announced that it completed the acquisition of PEAK:AIO, a pioneer in next-generation metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file systems. With this acquisition, NetApp can leverage metadata services and parallel namespace innovations to power the fastest storage on the planet, NetApp Novus, to support zettabyte-scale file systems for the most demanding workloads of AI clouds and GPU-as-a-service providers. For the best AI infrastructure economics, organizations need to keep GPU resources continuously supplied with data without bottlenecks. articles.title: NetApp Completes Acquisition of PEAK:AIO to Accelerate Zettabyte-scale AI Deployments
